snapshot_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 lines: <source-file SHA-256><two spaces><relative path><LF>. Scope: all src/ and public/ files, plus snapshot_extra_files. Hashes describe source inputs before standalone adaptations.

standalone_adaptations.src/recovery.ts: Standalone terminology in a comment; executable code unchanged.
standalone_adaptations.public/notices.html: Generated from local notices; photograph credit links to its source rather than workspace-only evidence.
standalone_adaptations.assets/photo/ATTRIBUTION.txt: Source link replaces a workspace-only evidence path.
standalone_adaptations.assets/photo/manifest.json: Only asset, attribution and licence metadata required by this standalone build is retained.
standalone_adaptations.package.json: Standalone name, scripts and packaging/test dependencies.
standalone_adaptations.package-lock.json: Standalone root package metadata; dependency versions preserved.

note: Synchronised shared frontend source from the stated commit. Standalone documentation, vendor input verification, packaging and regression tests are maintained separately. Later source edits are not automatically synchronised.

fetched_at_build.note: Pexels-licensed photographs are not stored in this repository. The script downloads each original from Pexels, verifies its SHA-256 and rebuilds these files; the hashes are the reference build.
